people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Nathanael
people.line: Disciple of Jesus, from Cana in Galilee.

translations.web: Nathanael answered him, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God! You are King of Israel!”
translations.bsb: “Rabbi,” Nathanael answered, “You are the Son of God! You are the King of Israel!”
translations.kjv: Nathanael answered and saith unto him, Rabbi, thou art the Son of God; thou art the King of Israel.
translations.asv: Nathanael answered him, Rabbi, thou art the Son of God; thou art King of Israel.
